environmentFactsFeedback: All injected facts held: @pen.dev/cli 0.3.5 exports deterministically via pen interactive Export (17/17 byte-identical across consecutive runs); PENCIL_CLI_KEY accepted; DESIGN_SPECS_GITHUB_PAT scoped as documented; the packaged pencil-design.md skill copy is superseded on CLI mechanics exactly as stated; GC-006's hhea text-placement constants re-verified. Facts worth promoting: (1) pen 0.3.5 text placement converges fastest by snapping the BROWSER baseline to the integer CSS-px grid first (Chromium disables vertical subpixel text positioning; device-grid 0.5px snapping REGRESSES - measured), then applying per-(family,weight,size) tunes calibrated by per-item local cross-correlation (medians here -0.6..+0.6 css; the dominant Heebo 400/14 face needed +0.43). (2) Do NOT snap rectangle/box edges to the device grid - Chromium does not pixel-snap painted box edges here and pen's fractional-coordinate AA is the closer model (snapping regressed every state ~2x). (3) DOMSnapshot carries NO input/textarea value or placeholder text (UA shadow) and NO list ::marker boxes - synthesize both (markers: disc d=fontSize/3, center 1.04*fontSize left of the li content edge, first-line middle). (4) textarea resize grips are UA paint - freeze with resize:none on both compare sides. (5) A same-message file-edit + node-run can race the file save in this workspace - one export cycle re-measured a stale byte-identical document (excluded from the iteration count as infra; verify the artifact changed before counting a round). RESUMED-DISPATCH facts worth promoting: (6) A dispatch can say first-capture while a stopped capture sits in the review lane — capture agents must check the lane before authoring (this run reused the settled mapping/recipe and spent its budget on the one failing state; re-authoring would have burned the budget re-deriving). (7) Playwright 1.58.2 here bundles Chromium headless-shell 145.0.7632.6 (prior run recorded 151): every recorded measurement reproduced EXACTLY, so the capture methodology is stable across these Chromium builds. (8) The last-mile residual after global per-face tunes is often NOT glyph AA: run a per-item window-slide alignment search (device-px argmin) — hairline borders offset by one device row read as uniform ~1.2k-px diff bands; text-dominated windows hide border offsets, so probe borders by row-profile when a band survives. (9) Playwright screenshot clip must be rounded to integer CSS px (Math.round of the rect) — flooring fractional heights yields off-by-one image sizes vs the frame (962.53 -> 1924 not 1926). (10) The global npm prefix is root-owned on this VM (EACCES): install @pen.dev/cli locally and call node_modules/.bin/pen.
